SELECT cgslam.ROAD_NAME ,asci.CAMERA_NM , SUM(ascarsfc.VHCL_TRFVLM ) AS SUM_TRFVLM , ROUND(SUM(ascarsfc.VHCL_TRFVLM) / COUNT(cgslam.ROAD_NAME),2) AS AVG_TRFVLM , ROUND(SUM(ascarsfc.AVG_VHCL_SPEED) / count(cgslam.ROAD_NAME),2) AS AVG_SPD FROM ADSI_SMCRSRD_CRSRD_ACS_ROAD_STATS_FIVMIN_CUR ascarsfc INNER JOIN ADSI_SMCRSRD_CRSRD_ACS_ROAD_INFO ascari ON ascarsfc.CRSRD_ID = ascari.CRSRD_ID AND ascarsfc.ACS_ROAD_ID = ascari.ACS_ROAD_ID INNER JOIN C_GM_STD_LINK_ADSTDG_MPPG cgslam ON ascari.LINK_ID = cgslam.LINK_ID INNER JOIN ADSI_SMCRSRD_CAMERA_INFO asci ON ascarsfc.CRSRD_ID = asci.CRSRD_ID AND ascarsfc.ACS_ROAD_ID = asci.ACS_ROAD_ID WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY cgslam.ROAD_NAME ,asci.CAMERA_NM ORDER BY cgslam.ROAD_NAME
LIMIT 10 OFFSET (#{page} - 1) * 10

SELECT COUNT(A.ROAD_NAME) FROM ( SELECT cgslam.ROAD_NAME FROM ADSI_SMCRSRD_CRSRD_ACS_ROAD_STATS_FIVMIN_CUR ascarsfc INNER JOIN ADSI_SMCRSRD_CRSRD_ACS_ROAD_INFO ascari ON ascarsfc.CRSRD_ID = ascari.CRSRD_ID AND ascarsfc.ACS_ROAD_ID = ascari.ACS_ROAD_ID INNER JOIN C_GM_STD_LINK_ADSTDG_MPPG cgslam ON ascari.LINK_ID = cgslam.LINK_ID INNER JOIN ADSI_SMCRSRD_CAMERA_INFO asci ON ascarsfc.CRSRD_ID = asci.CRSRD_ID AND ascarsfc.ACS_ROAD_ID = asci.ACS_ROAD_ID WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY cgslam.ROAD_NAME, asci.CAMERA_NM )A
